_note: Every recorded SITL flight and how to load it. python -m src.etl.sitl_rebuild reads this file. status 'flown': the mission was completed and goes into the detector database; any other status is summarised in sitl/RESULTS.md but not loaded. Paths are relative to sitl/. start_heading_deg: 353 is SITL's CMAC default; 180 faces the wind (sim_vehicle.py -l -35.363261,149.165230,584,180).

re-flown: the first attempt was stopped by hand during the landing descent (log not kept)
tail to the wind: never above 0.3 m in 11 min at full lift throttle
same settings facing the wind: mission flown
